hintProfile: Select the routing profile for this waypoint. The profile determines which paths and roads the routing engine prefers — choose between car, bicycle, or foot.
hintFast: When enabled, the routing engine prefers faster routes over shorter ones. Disable to find the most direct path instead.
brouterUnavailableMessage: The BRouter Offline Navigation app is not installed on this device. BRouter is the offline routing engine that powers route planning. Install it from F-Droid, Google Play, or GitHub to enable route calculation.
